title: 불변 기준 물량표와 ERP 현재 출고량의 읽기 전용 union grid

request.baselineId: exact lowercase 64-character hex id matching /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/ from the stored public baseline response; uppercase is rejected
request.bindings: optional fixed-shape object containing every user binding; omitted or empty is a valid discovery request
request.sheetScopes: optional own-property map keyed by a stored sheet id; each value is exactly {confirmed,groups:[{country,flower}]}. groups contains 1..10 exact server-catalog pairs and, when confirmed=true, must equal that sheet's server-derived unique candidate group set
request.keymapBatch: optional own-property map keyed by stored sheet id with {confirmRows,confirmClients}; true attests only the non-null row.key/client.key candidates displayed for that immutable sheet
request.rowOverrides: optional own-property map keyed by stored row id with {prodKey,confirmed}
request.columnOverrides: optional own-property map keyed by stored client id with {custKey,confirmed}
request.dateGroups: optional array of {columnIds,shipmentDate,confirmed}; every id must be a stored client id, may occur once only, and shipmentDate is a real user-selected YYYY-MM-DD
request.columnDateOverrides: optional own-property map keyed by stored client id with {shipmentDate,confirmed}; an explicit confirmed ISO date overrides its date group while preserving raw client.day
request.rowUnitOverrides: optional own-property map keyed by stored row id with {unit,confirmed} using explicit unit 박스|단|송이

response.catalog: active Product candidates include ProdKey, ProdName, DisplayName, CounName, FlowerName, OutUnit, BunchOf1Box, SteamOf1Box; active Customer candidates include CustKey and CustName
response.discovery: empty bindings returns catalog, server-resolved keymap candidates, CounName+FlowerName group candidates, bounded current evidence, and a union projection whose unconfirmed quantities have delta=null
response.unclassifiedCurrent: returned once at top level, never appended to every sheet; contains current rows outside a confirmed sheet scope or rows that cannot safely be assigned while category scope is uncertain
response.limitErrors: HTTP 422 CURRENT_RESULT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED or UNION_CELL_LIMIT_EXCEEDED; response is advisory, explicitly incomplete, and contains no partial projection or inferred zero

pureProjector.signature: reconcileDistributionBaseline({ baseline, bindings = {}, products, customers, currentRows, currentComplete = true }) -> { sheetCandidates, sheets, unclassifiedCurrent, issues }
pureProjector.baseline: the public baseline object returned by distributionBaselineStore, including id/year/week/coverage/parsed.sheets[{id,clients,rows}]
pureProjector.responseProjection: the pure function returns only {sheetCandidates,sheets,unclassifiedCurrent,issues}; the API wraps it with success, advisoryOnly, baseline{id,year,week,coverage}, scope, catalog, and observedAt

criteria.baselineAuthority: load exact year + week + baselineId through distributionBaselineStore; never accept parsed sheets or baseline cells from the browser
criteria.baselinePublicShape: id matches lowercase /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/ and parsed.sheets contain clients and rows; the panel must retain result.baseline.id after save and restore instead of treating confirmed timestamp as identity
criteria.weekScope: coverage=single reads the stored week only; coverage=combined is valid only for an -02 baseline and reads -01 plus -02 exactly once; every ERP SELECT includes explicit OrderYear and exact OrderWeek values
criteria.currentProjection: reuse the SELECT-only current-row shape from distributionChangeFacts: year, week, custKey, prodKey, SdetailKey, SdateKey, shipmentDate, qty, unit; do not invoke history analysis or any write path
criteria.productMetadata: read Product.CounName and Product.FlowerName directly, as already selected in lib/pivotStats.js near the order projection; never infer category from labels
criteria.scopeInference: only when every baseline row.key in a sheet resolves uniquely to one active Product, derive the unique set of exact Product CounName + FlowerName pairs; the set may contain 1..10 legitimate groups. Product OutUnit is displayed and confirmed separately. No label inference or free-text group expansion is allowed
criteria.scopeConfirmation: bindings.sheetScopes[sheetId].confirmed=true is accepted only with bindings.keymapBatch[sheetId].confirmRows=true and when its order-insensitive unique groups set exactly equals the server-derived candidate set. Those groups become ERP append scope; empty bindings previews the same set as ERP_CANDIDATE. Manual row overrides do not silently widen scope
criteria.scopeSafety: unconfirmed candidate groups may populate ERP_CANDIDATE evidence only; no ERP-only row is presented as a confirmed baseline omission. Current rows outside confirmed groups remain once in top-level unclassifiedCurrent
criteria.keyConfirmation: the UI first displays every resolved _keymap Product/Customer pair; one unchecked per-sheet batch checkbox may explicitly confirm all displayed non-null candidates. Manual overrides are required for missing or invalid keys
criteria.dateConfirmation: the UI groups columns by exact displayed raw client.day and lets the user choose one ISO date per group; per-column override is allowed. Weekday, 14/17, and 미정 are hints only, remain visible, and never derive a date
criteria.dateDistinction: invoice year/week selects ERP rows; shipmentDate selects a cell column. A shipment date is not derived from or required to fall inside the invoice week
criteria.unitConfirmation: unchecked original-export attestation yields no comparable baseline quantity. Checked means ordinary source cells retain Product.OutUnit and exporter-identified alstro cells normalize raw*16 to OutUnit; an explicit per-row unit may use only positive verified Product conversion ratios
criteria.union: preserve baseline sheet/row/column order; append only current ProdKeys and CustKey+shipmentDate pairs in that sheet's confirmed CounName+FlowerName group union, deterministically. OutUnit is verified separately and never expands or narrows category scope. Before confirmation show candidate additions as ERP_CANDIDATE; after confirmation mark ERP_ONLY with wording that is not a missing-workbook verdict
criteria.identity: preserve every current contribution by year|week|custKey|prodKey|SdetailKey|SdateKey; duplicate identity is an issue, never double-counted
criteria.currentLimit: query TOP 10001; if more than 10000 rows are observed, stop the entire projection with HTTP 422 CURRENT_RESULT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED and currentComplete=false. Never slice, aggregate, infer zero, or return a partial union
criteria.unknownCurrent: a LEFT JOIN result with null ShipmentDtm, null SdateKey, or null qty is unknown rather than zero and cannot enter an exact-date total. Any such row for the same confirmed ProdKey+CustKey blocks every related cell delta and remains visible as unresolved evidence
criteria.absentCurrent: erpCurrentQuantity=0 is allowed only when the current query is complete, all row/column/date/unit/group bindings are confirmed, no related unknown-date/quantity row exists, and no exact ProdKey+CustKey+shipmentDate contribution exists
criteria.baselineQuantity: only a finite numeric workbook value, including numeric zero, can be normalized. null, blank, text, formula-without-cache, NaN, and infinity are unknown and never become zero
criteria.numericComparison: delta=erpCurrentQuantity-baselineQuantity only when product, customer, exact date, unit, sheet group, and complete current query are confirmed and non-conflicting; valid zero remains numeric
criteria.cellLimit: sum of projected row-count multiplied by column-count across sheets must not exceed 100000; return HTTP 422 UNION_CELL_LIMIT_EXCEEDED with no partial cells while preserving the baseline and all ERP data
criteria.bindingSafety: all binding maps must be non-array plain JSON objects inspected through own properties only. Reject __proto__/prototype/constructor, unknown sheet/row/client ids, duplicate date-group column ids, and unexpected values; copy validated entries into Map or null-prototype objects and never spread or assign caller-controlled keys into ordinary prototypes
criteria.truthfulness: equal totals never mean request handled or workflow complete; missing current history/row never proves an omitted action; unresolved or truncated evidence keeps delta null
criteria.persistence: all bindings and projections are request-only in this slice; no baseline rewrite, binding store, cache write, lease, LLM call, ERP write, or automatic registration
criteria.workflow: all responses, validation failures, and request errors are advisory panel state only and never disable or guard existing parse/register/distribute/fix actions

crossYearFixture.description: A 2025 current row with the same OrderWeek, CustKey, and ProdKey is excluded from a 2026 baseline projection.

dnspyEvidence.note: The union grid reads current ERP evidence only; it does not replace or guard nenova.exe save/fix behavior.
